summary: Iteration 15: Tested BNPS Curriculum features and Math Rendering (KaTeX) implementation. Backend tested via internal API (external URL had transient 502 during pytest). All BNPS features working correctly. KaTeX CSS confirmed loaded in DOM. Minor UI issue: hardcoded 'NCERT' label shows for BNPS students on Syllabus page.

minor.issue: Transient 502 Bad Gateway during automated pytest run - backend recovers. Internal API works perfectly.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded 'NCERT' badge displayed for all subjects including BNPS students. Lines 104-105 and 149 show <ShieldCheck/> NCERT regardless of school.

issues: Onboarding wizard (STEP 1 OF 5) persists on every session for new BNPS student - no close/skip button visible. Blocks background UI but doesn't block actual functionality.

action_items: Fix SyllabusPage.jsx hardcoded 'NCERT' label - should display 'BNPS' or 'Brooklyn National' for brooklyn_national school users (lines 104-105, 149)
Consider adding a 'Skip' or 'Close' button to the onboarding wizard for existing/returning BNPS students
critical_code_review_comments: SyllabusPage.jsx lines 104-105, 149: 'NCERT' label hardcoded - not dynamic based on school. BNPS students see 'NCERT' instead of school-appropriate label
quiz.py line 175: 'Difficulty level:' appears twice in the prompt template (duplicate line 173 and 175) - minor but should be cleaned up

success_rate.backend: 90% (internal API 100%, external transient 502 during test run)
